Specification: This specification models a simple message-shuffling system with four constant message values M0 through M3. The system maintains a set of messages on the left, a set on the right, an iteration counter, and a send count; a Send step moves one message from left to right and increments count, while an Iteration step is enabled when left is empty and moves all right-side messages back to left while incrementing the iteration number. The temporal specification asserts initialization followed by arbitrary Next steps, and the file also defines an invariant stating that the union of left and right always equals the full Messages set, together with a temporal property [] Inv. The design also includes symmetry-related helper definitions using Permutations(Messages), a fixed iteration definition, and a view tuple.
